title: 第1022章 两虎相斗第1021章 金霄圣火
content_zh:
下一刻，叶霄炎眼神骤然一厉。
呼！
他体内气息猛然翻涌，白金色的圣星焚天炎顿时从他周身暴涌而出，宛如潮水一般席卷开来，瞬间将他整个人笼罩在内。
白金色火焰升腾间，带着一种极为纯粹而尊贵的气息，既有焚尽万物的炽烈，又有星辰般的灿烂璀璨，火焰在他身周缭绕盘旋，宛如披上了一层由星火凝成的战衣。
对付火焰，最好的方式，自然就是以火治火。
而且叶霄炎很清楚，眼前这金霄圣火既然已经化形为金霄火麟圣雀，那便绝不会轻易屈服。
既如此，那就只有正面镇压！
不过，虽然圣星焚天炎尚未真正达到化形的地步，但距离那一步，也已经不远了。
叶霄炎与叶霄尘心念相通，彼此对这道火焰的演化方向，也早已有过一致的判断。
龙！
他们都选择了龙形！
昂——！
随着白金色火焰不断汇聚、压缩、凝形，下一刻，一道低沉而雄浑的龙吟声便骤然从火焰深处传出。
紧接着，那团白金色的圣星焚天炎竟然迅速变化，化作一条庞大无比的白金色火焰巨龙。
那巨龙身躯修长，龙鳞层层叠叠，每一片都像是由白金色烈焰压缩而成，鳞片边缘流淌着炽热火光，宛如流金铸就。
龙首高昂，双角如剑，龙须飘扬，龙眸之中更是跳动着无尽火焰神芒，透着一种凌驾万灵之上的威严与霸道。
它盘旋于半空，龙躯蜿蜒，周身火焰翻卷，仿佛一条真正从远古火海中苏醒的神龙。
而它所散发出的压迫感，竟比真实的龙族还要来得更加可怕。
因为这不是血肉之躯的龙，而是火焰之灵所化的龙，是纯粹由毁灭与炽热凝成的龙！
那种灼热、锋锐、狂暴、霸道交织在一起的气息，令得周围空气都在疯狂扭曲，甚至连人的神魂都仿佛要被那股龙威烧灼得颤抖起来。

随着白金火龙现身，祭坛之上的金霄火麟圣雀也立刻发出一声尖锐的嘶鸣。
啾——！
它振翅长鸣，双翼猛然一展，金色火焰顿时如潮翻涌，整片广场的温度都在这一刻疯狂攀升。
同为火焰，天然便有排斥。
更何况，这两道火焰都已经强大到了近乎拥有灵智的地步。
同性相斥，彼此之间，根本容不得半分退让。
下一瞬，火龙与麟雀同时暴起。
轰隆！
两头由火焰凝成的庞然巨兽，狠狠碰撞在一起。
那一刹那，整座广场都仿佛剧烈震动了一下，狂暴的火浪朝着四面八方席卷而出，滚滚热流冲天而起，连空气都被烧得噼啪作响。
这不是寻常意义上的战斗。
而是两种至强火焰之间最原始、最凶残、最不讲道理的厮杀！
content_en:
The next moment, Ye Xiaoyan's eyes suddenly sharpened.
call!
The aura in his body surged suddenly, and the white-gold Holy Star Burning Sky Flame suddenly surged out from his body, sweeping away like a tide, instantly covering his entire body.
As the white-gold flames rose, they carried an extremely pure and noble aura. They were both fierce and blazing, as bright as stars. The flames swirled around him, as if he was covered in a battle suit made of sparks.
Naturally, the best way to deal with flames is to use fire to control fire.
And Ye Xiaoyan knew very well that since the Golden Sky Holy Fire in front of him had transformed into the Golden Sky Fire Lin Holy Bird, he would never give in easily.
In this case, there is only frontal suppression!
However, although Saint Star Fen Tianyan has not yet truly reached the stage of transformation, it is not far away from that step.
Ye Xiaoyan and Ye Xiaochen have the same mind, and they have already made unanimous judgments on the evolution direction of the flame.
dragon!
They all chose dragon form!
hold head high--!
As the white-gold flames continued to gather, compress, and condense, the next moment, a low and powerful dragon roar suddenly came from the depths of the flames.
Immediately afterwards, the white-gold Holy Star Burning Sky Flame suddenly changed rapidly and turned into a huge white-gold flame dragon.
The dragon's body was slender, and its scales were layered on top of each other. Each piece seemed to be compressed by white-golden flames, and the edges of the scales were filled with hot fire, as if they were made of flowing gold.
The dragon's head is held high, its horns are like swords, its whiskers are fluttering, and the dragon's eyes are beating with endless flames, revealing a kind of majesty and dominance that surpasses all spirits.
It hovers in mid-air, with its dragon body winding and flames rolling around it, like a divine dragon that has truly awakened from the ancient sea of ​​fire.
And the sense of oppression it exudes is actually more terrifying than the real dragon clan.
Because this is not a dragon of flesh and blood, but a dragon transformed by the spirit of fire, a dragon made purely of destruction and heat!
That hot, sharp, violent, and domineering aura intertwined together caused the surrounding air to twist crazily, and even people's souls seemed to be burned and trembled by the dragon's power.
As the platinum fire dragon appeared, the golden sky fire lin holy bird on the altar immediately let out a sharp scream.
Chirp——!
It flapped its wings and screamed, suddenly spread its wings, golden flames surged like a tide, and the temperature of the entire square rose crazily at this moment.
As they are both flames, they are naturally repulsive.
What's more, these two flames are already so powerful that they almost possess spiritual intelligence.
People of the same sex repel each other, and there is no room for compromise between them.
The next moment, the fire dragon and the phoenix burst into flames at the same time.
Boom!
Two giant beasts made of flames collided fiercely.
At that moment, the entire square seemed to shake violently, violent waves of fire swept out in all directions, billowing heat rose into the sky, and even the air was burned and crackling.
This is no ordinary battle.
It is the most primitive, cruel and unreasonable fight between the two most powerful flames!
